description: This is a Python source file implementing a client class 'GitLabClient' for interacting with the GitLab API. It provides methods for fetching files, directory listings, repository info, and other repository-related operations, supporting authentication and ref selection via tags or branches.

classes.name: GitLabClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with the GitLab API to fetch repository files, list directories, get repository info, and manage references such as tags and branches.

methods.name: __init__(self, config: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Initializes the GitLabClient with configuration parameters including project info, access token, auth method, ref (tag/branch), and base URL.

methods.name: None set_ref(self, ref: str)
methods.description: Overrides the default ref (tag or branch) used for fetching files and directory listings.

methods.name: Optional[str] get_file_content(self, file_path: str, *, ref: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Fetches the content of a specified file at a given ref, trying raw endpoint first, then falling back to JSON base64 content.

methods.name: Optional[str] _get_file_content_via_json(self, file_path: str, *, ref: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Fallback method to retrieve file content via the JSON API endpoint which returns base64-encoded data.

methods.name: List[str] list_files( self, directory_path: str = "", file_extension: str = ".prompt", recursive: bool = False, *, ref: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Lists files in a specified directory with a specific extension, supporting recursion.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] get_repository_info(self)
methods.description: Retrieves general information about the GitLab project/repository.

methods.name: bool test_connection(self)
methods.description: Tests connectivity to the GitLab project by attempting to retrieve repository info.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] get_branches(self)
methods.description: Retrieves a list of branches for the repository.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] get_file_metadata(self, file_path: str, *, ref: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Retrieves minimal metadata about a file (content type, size, last modified) via the raw endpoint headers.

methods.name: close(self)
methods.description: Closes the HTTP handler, freeing resources.
